section_definition: Intersection with Z=constant, only points Y<=-8mm retained to exclude posterior cranium/ear bulk; reported X extrema describe this explicitly clipped anterior-face section, not a whole-head or full cheek silhouette.

midline_profile.note: Original gaps are retained as missing samples, not filled. Same fixed coordinate plane; nose/lips/chin profile without claiming anatomical point correspondence.

limitations: Seven clipped horizontal sections and one sagittal profile are diagnostic curves, not every viewing silhouette or visual likeness certification.
